sources.title: L'evento alluvionale del 2-3 ottobre 2020 in Piemonte

curation_note.it: Il rapporto associa la stazione e il collasso al Sesia presso Campertogno, ma le coordinate del ponte sono approssimate. Il colmo descrive il contesto locale di piena; non è una misura alla sezione del manufatto.
curation_note.en: The report associates both station and collapse with the Sesia at Campertogno, but the bridge coordinates are approximate. The peak describes local flood context; it is not a bridge-section measurement.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official event report

caveats: The bridge coordinates in the ARCUS master record are approximate, therefore no station-to-bridge distance is calculated.
The 5.2 m peak and 4.0 m danger threshold refer to the ARPA Piemonte Campertogno station on the Sesia.
No bridge-section discharge or hydrograph is assigned.
The hydrometric observation describes local flood severity and does not by itself prove collapse causation.
